title: The Four Seasons
label: ch:seasons
canDo: I can name the four seasons in French and say that something happens in one of them.

payoff.summary: Four small Latin poems about heat, sleep and first things. printemps is primum tempus, "the first time"; ete is aestas, "heat"; hiver is hibernum, the wintry season that gave English hibernate. And three seasons take en while spring takes au, for a reason that is not about seasons at all.
payoff.note: Authored as part of the chapter-9 split: length is never a cost, so sixteen months-and-seasons became three chapters rather than one dense one. The payoff is atom-scored -- it assesses every atom its chapter introduces.
